name: Yoon Suk Yeol
position: President of the Republic of Korea
ideology: Conservatism, economic liberalism, robust US alliance, hardline North Korea deterrence
foreign_policy_position: Global Pivotal State doctrine; full alignment with the United States and NATO; historic rapprochement with Japan leading to the Camp David trilateral security framework; active conventional deterrence against North Korea.
current_status: In office, serving single 5-year presidential term through May 2027; navigating divided government against an opposition-controlled National Assembly.
